    How the rating works

    Autonomous 25%, stacking 35%, toggle defense 30%, and driving 10%. Ratings are match estimates on a 100-point scale. Low coverage pulls the rating toward 50.

    Placement timing measures the gap between observed driver-control stack additions. Loader travel measures movement from a loader to a goal. Driving speed uses 0.6-second windows supported by robot detections. A contested hold requires a robot and an opponent near a toggle that stays on the robot’s alliance color.

      How these stats are counted

      Pin halves added counts positive changes in visible placed pin halves. Toggle changes count changes in the settled field-facing color. A goal visit needs at least 0.5 seconds near a goal. Distance and heatmaps use tracked positions during active play.
